name: Convert network neuro matrix to conmat
summary: Converts one measure's matrix from the Network Neuro raw networkmatrices output, with its parcellation key, into a conmat datatype.
description: Copies <measure>.csv from the networkmatrices output into cm/csv/correlation.csv and builds label.json from the parcellation key (plus 14 FreeSurfer subcortical labels) and index.json. Temporary bridge until Network Neuro outputs conmat directly; may be deprecated.

inputs.description: The path to the top directory of the network matrices app
The path to the parcellation/volume datatype used to generate the network matrices

parameters.description: Which network matrix to convert (the CSV <measure>.csv in the networkmatrices output), for example density or count.

options.description: mean ad scaled by inverse volume of nodes
